# MIDV-2020 Dataset Status

## Overview
MIDV-2020 is a large-scale identity document benchmark consisting of 1,000 unique mock identity documents, 1,000 scanned images, 1,000 photos, and 1,000 video clips captured across various devices and lighting conditions.

## Status: WAITING_FOR_HUMAN_ACCESS
The official distribution (~124 GB) is hosted on the University of La Rochelle sFTP server and requires submitting a formal request form.

### Human Action Required:
1. Open the official access request form: `https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdxB1gvdVlRcARUlMolTJzyqY93XBZHhwiBwkDx8BDyMIPWIg/viewform`
2. Complete the institutional request details.
3. Upon receiving credentials, download the recommended photo/scan evaluation subset and place under `data/external/midv-2020/`.
